correctness.rationale: A coordinate flip acts on a Walsh character by -1 precisely for coordinates of its support. Orthonormalization and grouping characters by support size therefore give eigenvalues 2k and the stated signed binomial sums with normalization 2^-d. The Q5 denominator is strictly positive. The two transformed antipodal numerators cover [0,1/6) and [1/6,infinity) without a gap, so all six distance classes are strictly positive at every h>0. Coordinate-constant lifting intertwines the Laplacians and hence their invertible polynomial updates; summing over extensions passes strict positivity to lower dimensions. The Q6 fraction and its two positive regimes concern a single distance class, not a global positivity window. At zero the matrix is the identity; the large-step limit is the constant-mode projector.
correctness.replay_evidence: The independent script rebuilt all six Q5 numerator arrays and both strictly positive transformed arrays, independently found zero positive roots of P5 by Sturm, and reproduced the Q6 fraction -26706475/4942948029056 and Taylor coefficients 50,-1260. It additionally found exactly two positive roots of the reduced Q6 antipodal numerator and compared all 64 entries on Q3 with direct rational inversion at h=2/7. The infinite-timestep claim uses the polynomial certificates, not the direct test.
residual_risks: Exact computer-assisted coefficient calculation, not formal verification. The result makes no all-entry claim on Q6 near the witnessed failure.

value.rationale: The Boolean cube is a natural family of growing product graphs. All-step positivity preserves the discrete maximum principle for this mass-preserving update, whereas spectral contractivity is insufficient. The verified threshold goes well beyond the graph-order sufficient range and the exact witness distinguishes loss and recovery of one transition coefficient from a small-step instability.
residual_risks: No new integrator or full Q6 positivity set is established.
